source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Rear Suspension and Drive Line, p.4-6

procedures.title: Rear wheel bearings: check end play
steps: (continued) Rest the indicator pointer on the flange or spindle end (see figure 10 in the manual).
Push and pull the brake disc in and out while reading the indicator.
If end play is between .001" and .008", no adjustment is needed; otherwise note the reading and adjust as below.

procedures.title: Rear wheel bearings: adjust
steps: Set the parking brake so the spindle cannot turn, then remove the cotter pin and spindle nut.
Release the parking brake and pull the drive spindle flange off the splined spindle end.
Remove the brake caliper and disc (see Section 5).
Fit thread protector J-21859-1 on the spindle threads, then pull the drive spindle out of its support with tool J-22602 (see figure 11 in the manual).
Take the shim and bearing spacer out of the spindle support.
Note the old shim size. If end play read over .008", choose a shim thinner by the excess; if under .001", choose one thicker by the shortfall.
notes: Caution: keep the J-22602 puller plate vertical in the torque control arm before putting load on the puller screw.
Worked example: reading .011" (.003" too much); old shim .145"; new shim .139" (.006" thinner) gives .005" end play, which is in range.
